records.name: Spinning Blade
records.unlock_method: Ultimate Finish reward from PQ15 - Gotta Find That Dragon Ball!
records.effect: Spins around the opponent and slashes with Ki blades, launching them.

records.name: Psychic Move
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 73 - Frieza's Siege Against Earth
records.effect: Teleports behind the opponent and creates a shockwave that knocks them away.

records.name: Energy Barrier
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 32 - Multiple Cell Jr. Hunt
records.effect: Deploys a barrier that cancels Ki Waves; holding the input consumes Ki to maintain it.

records.name: Buu Buu Ball
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 88 - Evil Seeks Dragon Balls Yet Again!
records.effect: Transforms the user into a bouncing ball that can be freely moved and deals minor contact damage.

notes: Spinning Blade has an explicit Ultimate Finish acquisition statement in Dragon Ball Wiki, so ultimate_finish_required is true. The current DBXV2 page lists TP Medal Shop while Dragon Ball Wiki documents the PQ15 UF route; this is preserved as a source conflict rather than silently replacing one with the other. Energy Barrier's current Fandom Evasive overview gives PQ32 and 300 Stamina; GameFAQs corroborates the 300-Stamina barrier behavior.
